messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a public holiday that falls on a weekday and is surrounded by at least one weekend day, giving you a three‑day break.)

| Date Range | Holiday(s) | Notes |
|------------|------------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – Jan 3** | New Year’s Day (Sunday) | New Year’s Day fell on a Sunday, so the weekend itself is a long weekend. |
| **Feb 18 – Feb 20** | Family Day (Monday, Feb 20) | Observed in Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, and Manitoba. |
| **Mar 31 – Apr 3** | Good Friday (Friday) & Easter Monday (Monday) | Observed in most provinces; gives a four‑day break. |
| **May 20 – May 22** | Victoria Day (Monday, May 22) | Observed in all provinces except Quebec. |
| **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Canada Day (Saturday) | Canada Day fell on a Saturday, so the weekend itself is a long weekend. |
| **Sep 2 – Sep 4** | Labour Day (Monday, Sep 4) | Observed nationwide. |
| **Oct 7 – Oct 9** | Thanksgiving (Monday, Oct 9) | Observed nationwide. |
| **Nov 11 – Nov 13** | Remembrance Day (Saturday) | Remembrance Day fell on a Saturday, so the weekend itself is a long weekend. |
| **Dec 23 – Dec 25** | Christmas (Monday, Dec 25) | Observed nationwide. |

> **Pro‑Tip:** If you’re planning trips, remember that some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island). Those can also create extra long weekends if they fall on a weekday.  

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app!
